claim: To allow an S3 bucket from another AWS account to publish event notifications to your SNS topic, you configure the topic's access policy: the policy should grant the Amazon S3 service (s3.amazonaws.com) the permissions to publish to the topic, and the SourceAccount condition ensures that only the specified AWS account, which owns the bucket, can publish notifications to the topic.

qualifiers.scope: SNS topic access policy, S3 event notifications from a bucket in another account

evidence.quote: To allow an Amazon S3 bucket from another AWS account to publish event notifications to your Amazon SNS topic, you need to configure the topic's access policy accordingly.

The policy should grant the Amazon S3 service (s3.amazonaws.com) the necessary permissions to publish to your Amazon SNS topic. You will use the SourceAccount condition to ensure only the specified AWS account, which owns the Amazon S3 bucket, can publish notifications to your topic.
